result.title: Create the first owner from the server link
result.acceptance:
**Expected behaviour** · Issue a local, time-limited setup claim only on an empty installation. Create the owner, accept optional unverified email and show the one-time recovery code.

**Verify** · Use competing tabs, expired claim and lost response. Exactly one owner and Home exist. Reopening an initialized store takes the normal sign-in path.

**Delivery dependencies** · WI-056, WI-057, WI-058

**Queue** · Follows WI-058 in the v0.3 delivery order.

**Target** · PI-03, v0.3.
